task: fixed-prediction GOSPA scale sensitivity and physical resolution reference
main_experiment: fixed saved final medoid predictions, probability threshold .5; optimal partial assignment recomputed for each scale; no retraining or trajectory changes

statistics.endpoint: 240 min global sqrt(weighted mean squared GOSPA)
statistics.auc: 30-240 min trapezoidal mean squared GOSPA / 210 min
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over two primary endpoints within each scale; sensitivity across 15 correlated scales is exploratory, no independent confirmatory claims across scales

tie: exact enumeration in increasing cardinality and lexicographic index order; update only if cost < best-1e-12
weighting: fixed saved weights, equal 1/4096; subsets conditional normalized weights

physical_definition.root: first positive displacement where squared steering correlation=.5; dense brackets then Brent root
physical_definition.gain: 5 dB retained engineering scale; not inferred from aperture

D1.scope: 10 seeds x4 branches, 240-min endpoint only; regenerate full 3-member outputs from frozen weights/features; S0 and S_phys medoid selection and cross-scoring; fixed threshold .5 and same NMS

D2.trigger: ranking reversal, mean primary effect changes >5 percentage points, or major K>=2/second-related assignment changes requiring optimization diagnosis
D2.maximum: 3 fixed historical pairs; at most S0/S_phys/most-changing scale; no new RF
D2.decision_rule: consider only after C; robust main conclusions may stop without D2; report trigger and rationale explicitly

protection: all old experiments/ckm_sim/paper/root handoff/Overleaf read-only; llama-server remains stopped

plots.font: genuine Microsoft Times New Roman regular/bold/italic/bolditalic, embedded TrueType, verified with pdffonts
